summary: Iteration 92 - Object Storage Integration Testing Complete. All 19 tests passed. Verified that file uploads for pricing imports, documents, and order attachments now use Emergent Object Storage instead of local filesystem. Download endpoints continue to work correctly with backward compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: Object storage implementation is clean and follows best practices
Storage key initialization is lazy-loaded and cached properly in storage_config.py
All three upload endpoints (pricing-setup/imports, documents, orders/upload) correctly store files in object storage with storage_path and storage_backend fields
Download endpoints correctly retrieve files from object storage and return proper content
Migration endpoint for pricing imports returns valid no-op response when no legacy files exist
Backward compatibility maintained - existing list/stats endpoints work without errors
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during tests (TEST_ObjectStorage_Document, TEST_ObjectStorage_Customer order)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 92 verified object storage integration: (1) POST /api/pricing-setup/imports stores CSV files in object storage with storage_path containing 'signguy-ai/pricing-imports', (2) POST /api/pricing-setup/imports/migrate-storage returns valid migration stats (no-op if no legacy files), (3) POST /api/documents stores uploads in object storage with storage_backend='emergent_object_storage', (4) GET /api/documents/{id}/download returns valid base64 file_data from object storage, (5) POST /api/orders/{order_id}/upload stores attachments in object storage, (6) GET /api/orders/{order_id}/files/{file_id}/content returns raw file bytes from object storage. All backward compatibility endpoints working.
